tool_schemas.name: text_editor
tool_schemas.description: Runs a single workspace operation against an absolute `path` and returns the resulting file view or edit result: `view` lists a directory or returns file contents (optionally constrained by `view_range`), `create` writes a new file with `file_text`, `str_replace` deterministically replaces occurrences of `old_str` with `new_str`, `insert` inserts `new_str` after `insert_line` (1-indexed), and `undo_edit` reverts the most recent recorded edit for that file. Listing and file viewing are not paged; file views may be range-limited via `view_range` but otherwise return the full content. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when required fields for the chosen `command` are missing, `view_range`/`insert_line` are out of bounds, or `str_replace` cannot be applied deterministically (e.g., `old_str` not found or matches ambiguously); NOT_FOUND when `path` (or its parent directory for `create`) does not exist; CONFLICT when `create` targets an existing file or `undo_edit` is requested with no undo history for that file; PERMISSION_DENIED when the caller is not allowed to read/write the target path.

command.description: The commands to run. Allowed options are: `view`, `create`, `str_replace`, `insert`, `undo_edit`.

path.description: Absolute path to file or directory, e.g. `/repo/file.py` or `/repo`.

file_text.description: Required parameter of `create` command, with the content of the file to be created.

insert_line.description: Required parameter of `insert` command. The `new_str` will be inserted AFTER the line `insert_line` of `path`.

new_str.description: Optional parameter of `str_replace` command containing the new string (if not given, no string will be added). Required parameter of `insert` command containing the string to insert.

old_str.description: Required parameter of `str_replace` command containing the string in `path` to replace.

view_range.description: Optional parameter of `view` command when `path` points to a file. If none is given, the full file is shown. If provided, the file will be shown in the indicated line number range, e.g. [11, 12] will show lines 11 and 12. Indexing at 1 to start. Setting `[start_line, -1]` shows all lines from `start_line` to the end of the file.

description.description: The reason you are using the text editor (max 80 chars)

tool_schemas.name: projects_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status or name. Returns a paginated list; refuses invalid pagination parameters.

name_contains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring match on project name.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: projects_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single project by id. Returns the project if found; refuses unknown ids.

tool_schemas.name: projects_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of a project, including lifecycle state transitions. Returns the updated project; refuses illegal status transitions or unknown ids.

status.description: Optional new status. Allowed transitions: active->readonly/disabled, readonly->active/disabled, disabled->(none).

tool_schemas.name: fs_nodes_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists filesystem nodes within a project, optionally under a path prefix. Returns nodes and basic metadata; refuses unknown project ids.

project_id.description: Project id to list nodes from.

path_prefix.description: Optional absolute path prefix to scope results (e.g. "/repo/src").

limit.description: Maximum number of nodes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: edit_operations_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded edit operations, optionally filtered by project, path, node, command, or status. Returns a paginated audit trail; refuses invalid filters.

node_id.description: Optional filter by fs node id.

path.description: Optional exact match filter by absolute path.

created_after.description: Optional filter for operations created strictly after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Optional filter for operations created strictly before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.
